bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the commissioner of agriculture for an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+YOUTH AGRICULTURAL TRAINING PROGRAM. +]

[+The commissioner of agriculture must establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. The program must offer training in traditional and modern farming practices, sustainable agriculture, entrepreneurship, and community engagement. The program must provide mentorship opportunities to Black youth who are interested in farming. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture to establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the commissioner of agriculture for an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. YOUTH AGRICULTURAL TRAINING PROGRAM.

The commissioner of agriculture must establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. The program must offer training in traditional and modern farming practices, sustainable agriculture, entrepreneurship, and community engagement. The program must provide mentorship opportunities to Black youth who are interested in farming.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture to establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: The commissioner of agriculture must establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. The program must offer training in traditional and modern farming practices, sustainable agriculture, entrepreneurship, and community engagement. The program must provide mentorship opportunities to Black youth who are interested in farming.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture to establish an agricultural training program for Black youth at historical Black-owned farms in rural Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
